2900: Battle::AbilityEffects::OnSwitchIn.add(:NEUTRALIZINGGAS,
2901:   proc { |ability, battler, battle, switch_in|
2902:     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler, true)
2903:     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
2904:     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("Neutralizing gas filled the area!"))
2905:     battle.allBattlers.each do |b|
2906:       # Slow Start - end all turn counts
2907:       b.effects[PBEffects::SlowStart] = 0
2908:       # Truant - let b move on its first turn after Neutralizing Gas disappears
2909:       b.effects[PBEffects::Truant] = false
2910:       # Gorilla Tactics - end choice lock
2911:       if !b.hasActiveItem?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF])
2912:         b.effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil
2913:       end
2914:       # Illusion - end illusions
2915:       if b.effects[PBEffects::Illusion]
2916:         b.effects[PBEffects::Illusion] = nil
2917:         if !b.effects[PBEffects::Transform]
2918:           battle.scene.pbChangePokemon(b, b.pokemon)
2919:           battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} wore off!", b.pbThis, b.abilityName))
2920:           battle.pbSetSeen(b)
2921:         end
2922:       end
2923:     end
2924:     # Trigger items upon Unnerve being negated
2925:     battler.ability_id = nil   # Allows checking if Unnerve was active before
2926:     had_unnerve = battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility([:UNNERVE, :ASONECHILLINGNEIGH, :ASONEGRIMNEIGH])
2927:     battler.ability_id = :NEUTRALIZINGGAS
2928:     if had_unnerve && !battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility([:UNNERVE, :ASONECHILLINGNEIGH, :ASONEGRIMNEIGH])
2929:       battle.allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbItemsOnUnnerveEnding }
2930:     end
2931:   }
2932: )

2934: Battle::AbilityEffects::OnSwitchIn.add(:PASTELVEIL,
2935:   proc { |ability, battler, battle, switch_in|
2936:     next if battler.allAllies.none? { |b| b.status == :POISON }
2937:     battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(battler)
2938:     battler.allAllies.each do |b|
2939:       next if b.status != :POISON
2940:       b.pbCureStatus(Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH)
2941:       if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
2942:         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} cured {3}'s poisoning!",
2943:            battler.pbThis, battler.abilityName, b.pbThis(true)))
2944:       end
2945:     end
2946:     battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(battler)
2947:   }
